content.rendered:
One of the fun things about spring (because this year I can’t say the sun) is Hawks View’s annual carnival!  Our Cinco de Mayo theme this year is going to make it extra festive!

Our fundraising coordinator has been busy at work getting everything organized and planned (and she’s nailing it), but we won’t be able to make it happen without you, our incredible parent volunteers!

  • The carnival is Friday, May 5. 
  • First shift is 3:30 pm – 5:50 pm
  • Second shift is 5:50 pm – 8:30 pm

Some slots have been filled with high school students, but there are still lots left and if we can all pitch in, it makes the work easier for everyone!  And if you haven’t ever volunteered at a carnival, it is really FUN!

THANK YOU for all you do to help make our community so great!  

Please use the link below to view the available slots and sign up!  Be sure you have completed your background check and shown proof of your Covid vaccination to the office staff.  If you need a vaccination exception form, please contact the office at 503-825-5400.

Hawks View Elementary PAC: Spring Carnival Volunteer Sign Up (signupgenius.com)
